response.sql: WITH constructor_counts AS (SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) as record_count FROM constructors c LEFT JOIN constructorStandings cs ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) as avg_record_count FROM constructor_counts) SELECT cc.constructorId, cc.nationality, cc.record_count, cc.record_count - ac.avg_record_count as difference_from_average FROM constructor_counts cc CROSS JOIN avg_count ac ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC LIMIT 10
